title: The Elder Scrolls Online

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · Bethesda Softworks build
custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on The Elder Scrolls Online as an MMO digital holding within The Elder Scrolls series.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows or macOS through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and Bethesda / ZeniMax online services.
preservation.concerns: Always-online MMO structure creates high preservation risk: server dependency, chapter/DLC rotation, and account authentication. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: The Elder Scrolls Online originally launched in 2014 outside Steam. The Steam storefront date for this edition is May 22, 2017. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody under the Steam distribution path.
preservation.availability: Held as a permanent digital license on the archive Steam account while that custody and the required online services continue.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.
